# Indifferent [Attitude]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Social Interaction](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#IndifferentAttitude)*

An Indifferent creature has no desire to help or hinder you. Indifferent is the default attitude of a monster. *See also* "[Influence](../Combat/Actions/Influence.md)."
